title: Itbaq and infitah: covered and open letters: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-Mutaffifin and the sifat of weakness and emphasis
source: Written for quran/y6 lesson 19 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Itbaq and infitah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 19. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Itbaq: the covered letters
points: The tongue rises and covers the roof

keywords.def: a quality of how a letter is said
the tongue covers the roof of the mouth: ص ض ط ظ
the tongue stays open from the roof of the mouth: all other letters
the back of the tongue rises: a heavy letter

questions.a: ط is itbaq: the tongue covers the roof of the mouth, so it sounds full and heavy.

questions.q: Itbaq hunt (pupil PDF): circle every ص ض ط ظ in 83:1 to 6 and say each word. Today's rota group recites 83:1 to 6.
Extend: write the four itbaq letters and their open partners.
questions.a: ص س, ط ت, ظ ذ, ض د.

questions.q: Stretch: why is every itbaq letter also a heavy letter, but not every heavy letter itbaq?
questions.a: Itbaq letters also raise the tongue (isti'la); خ غ ق raise it but do not cover the roof.
A) س. The four itbaq letters are ص ض ط ظ; س is open (infitah).

questions.q: How many itbaq letters are there?
Think again: Say 'saad' then 'seen', 'taa' (ط) then 'taa' (ت). Where does your tongue go differently?
questions.a: For ص and ط the middle of the tongue rises and covers the roof of the mouth; for س and ت it does not.
